instruction: Build a login screen following my conventions: a full-screen branded background image, a vertically centered translucent form card (max width 400), Customer ID and password fields with labels, and an elevated LOGIN button.

Create a password text field with a visibility toggle, following my text field conventions: the brand border is always on and never restyled on focus, rounded corners, light blue fill, and a 14px bold label.
Convert this button to my button style: always elevated (pushed-up look), brand cyan background, dark grey text. Never flat, never outlined.
output:
ElevatedButton(
  onPressed: () {},
  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF4AC9E3),
    foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF353535),
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
    ),
    elevation: 2,
  ),
  child: const Text(
    'SUBMIT',
    style: TextStyle(
      fontSize: 16,
      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
      letterSpacing: 0.5,
    ),
  ),
)

instruction: Build a sign-up screen reusing my login page patterns: full-screen branded background image, vertically centered translucent card, name / email / password / confirm-password fields, and an elevated SIGN UP button.
Build a registration form (username, password, confirm password) following my conventions. It must not flutter when tapping between fields.
Fix this form — it flutters when tapping between the fields because each field uses a different keyboard layout. Follow my convention: one keyboard type across the whole form.
input:
TextFormField(
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
),
TextFormField(
  keyboardType: TextInputType.visiblePassword,
  obscureText: true,
  textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
),

instruction: Build a feedback screen with a movable panel following my conventions: it has a text field and a SEND button; when the keyboard opens I can drag the panel up in Y so the button stays reachable; when the keyboard closes it pins back to its centered position.
Convert this screen to my movable panel pattern: the keyboard covers the button and there is no way to reveal it. Keep the brand image background full-screen.

Build an action button following my conventions: tapping it submits a defect claim to an API. Show a spinner inside the button while the work runs, disable the button, and only navigate to the review screen if the API result requires it.

Build a navigation button following my conventions: tapping it immediately opens the order history screen, which shows a white background with a centered spinner while its data loads, then displays the orders.

Build an app shell following my conventions: the system status bar (time, signal, wifi, battery) is always visible, its background matches the header color, and the icon brightness adapts to whether the header is dark or light.
Fix this screen to follow my convention: the status bar must always be visible (time, signal, wifi, battery). It currently hides it in immersive mode.

Build a preselection setting page following my conventions: a list of option cards with the standard search bar, the current selection shown prominently (sorted first), re-tapping the current selection navigates with no API call, and the API fires only on an actual change.
Build the wizard heading row for a setting page following my conventions: minimal heading with the count on the left, and the next-setting control on the same line to save space.
Add my standard search bar above a card list: search icon, inline hint text, and it filters the cards on type as I type. Client-side only — no button.
This card list needs server-side filtering — convert it to my convention: an explicit search button that fires the API. No on-type API calls.
input:
TextField(
  decoration: const InputDecoration(hintText: 'Search within list'),
  onChanged: (value) => _searchOnServer(value), // fires API per keystroke
)

instruction: Convert this layout to my convention: absolutely no nested vertical scrolls — one scroll at the page level.
Add my forced-exit warning to this setting screen's home button: tapping it must always warn that data will be lost. No change tracking — always warn.
input:
IconButton(
  icon: const Icon(Icons.home, color: Colors.white),
  tooltip: 'Home',
  onPressed: () => context.go('/home'),
)

instruction: Build a selection card list following my conventions: white cards with shadow, green border for the selected card and cyan for the rest, with matching Current/Select buttons.

Build a bottom navigation bar following my conventions: black bar spanning the full width edge to edge, white icons with titles below, active tab in brand cyan (0xFF4AC9E3), and red badge support showing the cart item count.
Convert this default BottomNavigationBar to my bottom navigation style: black full-width bar, white icons with titles below, active tab in brand cyan.
input:
BottomNavigationBar(
  currentIndex: _index,
  onTap: (i) => setState(() => _index = i),
  items: const [
    BottomNavigationBarItem(icon: Icon(Icons.home), label: 'Home'),
    BottomNavigationBarItem(icon: Icon(Icons.search), label: 'Search'),
    BottomNavigationBarItem(icon: Icon(Icons.shopping_cart), label: 'Cart'),
  ],
)

instruction: Add my red badge style to this bottom navigation cart icon: red circle with the white count, capped at 99+, only shown when the count is above zero.
Build the post-login app shell following my conventions: white background pages, and the black bottom navigation rendered on every page from the shared shell — pages never build their own footer.
Build a page header following my conventions: a circular black back button on the left, a centered title, and a reserved 44px slot on the right for a page-specific action icon (kept even when empty).
Fix this page header to follow my conventions: the title drifts off-center when there is no right-side icon, and the back button is too small to tap comfortably.
